llmnav-catalog/1 repository=llmnav catalog=llmnav.diagnostics
Read semantic cards before opening source. Resolve current paths and signatures with llmnav query or show.

@llmnav.diagnostics.sarif
role Serialize deterministic LLMNav diagnostics as a SARIF 2.1.0 result log.
owns SARIF schema mapping, diagnostic rule table, artifact locations
excludes diagnostic discovery, file writes
rel workflow>llmnav.rules.validate

@llmnav.diagnostics.editor
role Serialize deterministic editor ranges and publish bounded editor task integrations.
owns editor diagnostic schema, zero-based ranges, VS Code task configuration
excludes editor extension runtime, absolute workspace URIs, source mutation
rel workflow>llmnav.rules.validate

@llmnav.diagnostics.doctor
role Diagnose project configuration, generated cache integrity, and recoverable generation state.
owns project health checks, cache integrity checks, release readiness diagnostics
excludes source formatting, package publication
invariant Only interrupted generation recovery may mutate state; all other health checks are read-only.
rel workflow>llmnav.index.generate
